products.name: ”SOFT” Gel Cleanser
products.description: Gentle Green Tea & Aloe Vera Face Wash for All Skin Types
products.fullDescription: ”SOFT” Gel Cleanser is a gentle, everyday face wash formulated with Aloe Vera, Green Tea Extract, and Panthenol to cleanse the skin without stripping away its natural moisture. Its mild cleansing system effectively removes dirt, excess oil, and impurities while helping to keep skin feeling soft, fresh, comfortable, and balanced. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and acne-prone skin.
benefits: Gently cleanses without stripping the skin
Removes dirt, excess oil, and daily impurities
Helps soothe and calm the skin
Helps maintain skin hydration
Supports a healthy skin barrier
Leaves skin feeling fresh, soft, and balanced
products.ingredients: Aqua, Sodium methyl cocoyl taurate, Cocamidopropyl betaine, Glycerin, Propanediol,  Aloe barbadensis leaf extract, Camellia sinensis extract (Green tea), Sodium lauroyl sarcosinate, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol and ethylhexylglycerin, Polysorbate 20, Xanthan gum, Disodium EDTA
products.howToUse: Apply a small amount to wet skin and gently massage over the face for 30–60 seconds, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use morning and evening, then follow with your serum and moisturizer.

products.name: Glow C Serum
products.description: Brightening Vitamin C & Alpha Arbutin Serum for Dark Spots and Uneven Skin Tone
products.fullDescription: Glow C Serum is a lightweight brightening serum formulated with 7% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid and 2% Alpha Arbutin to help improve the appearance of dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dull-looking skin. Designed for daily use, it helps reveal a brighter, more radiant-looking complexion while providing antioxidant care.
benefits: Brightens dull-looking skin
Helps fade the appearance of dark spots and post-blemish marks
Helps even out skin tone
Provides antioxidant protection
Supports a healthy, radiant-looking complexion
Lightweight and suitable for daily use
products.ingredients: Aqua(water), Butylene glycol, Ethyl ascorbic acid, Alpha arbutin,Diglucosyl Gallic Acid (and) Thymus hydrolysate (and) Pomegranate stem cell Extract, Sodium PCA, Wheat Amino acids, Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Hydroxyproline, Dimethicone, Ammonium acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP copolymer,Phenoxyethanol and ethylhexylglycerin, Polyacrylate Crosspolymer-6, Disodium EDTA

products.name: Pore Balance
products.description: 10% Niacinamide & Zinc PCA Serum for Oily, Acne-Prone Skin and Visible Pores
